messages:
maria-l: heads up — multiple customers reporting tool-invoke failures from the golden-suite CI hitting production traffic. getting 502s and some responses with "invalid args". opening thread to triage, tagging eng-ml and oncall.

kenji-s: i pulled a few failing payloads. root cause looks like schema mismatch: `user_context` used to be a single string but some golden prompts are now sending an array. validator throws `unexpected_type`. example payload we saw: 

```
{
  "tool": "price_lookup",
  "args": {
    "sku": "ZP-77",
    "user_context": ["eu-central", "alpha"]
  }
}
```

validator expects `user_context: string | null`. arrays -> `unexpected_type`.

oliver: besides the schema errors, there are intermittent 401/403 spikes in the same window. traces show token refresh calls timing out to the auth provider. replayed a curl and got 401 after ~1.1s. linking trace: https://observability.internal/redwood/trace/txn-88b2 (internal).

qa_jen: repro on my laptop: run `pytest tests/invoke/test_fn_invoke.py::TestGolden::test_contracts -k user_context` and it fails with `AssertionError: expected string, got list`. steps: `git checkout main && pytest tests/invoke/test_fn_invoke.py::TestGolden::test_contracts -q`. attaching local failure log.

maria-l: proposed triage plan: (1) collect 10 failed request IDs + raw request bodies from logs (2) run schema-lint across the golden corpus to find other shape drifts (3) add a tolerant deserializer as a short-term mitigation that coerces common shapes (4) add a CI regression that fuzzes arg shapes so this can't slip through again. can @deploy-bot create an incident and kick off the collection job?

deploy-bot: :robot_face: created incident INC-2028 and scheduled log-collector for window 2026-03-17T09:00Z -> 2026-03-17T11:00Z. assigned to eng-ml oncall. canary rollback blocked for private clusters.

kenji-s: quick short-term mitigation: implement a tolerant acceptor for `user_context` that will stringify arrays (comma-joined) and accept nulls. will open PR with unit tests and deprecation logs. long-term: extend the tool-adapter contract to accept arrays and update the model-to-tool mapping docs.

oliver: i'll add extra auth diagnostics (log token issuer+expiry+error codes) and a synthetic token-refresh monitor every 30s. if refresh fails >3 times, circuit-break the refresh and swap to reserved tokens.

qa_jen: while kenji builds the acceptor, i'll add a `fninvoke-shape-fuzz` regression to CI that mutates arg shapes (string <-> array <-> object) and runs the golden prompts through schema-lint and the invoke harness. we should include a golden-case where `user_context` appears as both string and array. note: this will add ~10-15% runtime to the full corpus run; propose running it on merges and nightly full-runs. filing CRO ticket for infra cost.

maria-l: owners: kenji-s (deserializer PR + adapter), oliver (auth tracing + monitor), qa_jen (CI regression + corpus lint), maria-l (incident lead + customer comms).

hana-cs: update for customers: YottaPay reported checkout errors. i told them were investigating and suggested short-term retry + bump client timeout. they asked for ETA and we told them 2 hours for a mitigation.

kenji-s: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/879 — adds tolerant deserializer, unit tests, and a schema-lint rule to flag arrays where strings are expected. pushing for a hotfix to canary in the next 6 hours.

oliver: staging looks good: auth monitor passing, additional logs show token refresh latency reduced after retry logic. planning hotfix canary deploy in 4-6 hours, then observe 24h before wider rollout.

qa_jen: CI note: enabling shape-fuzz on all PRs would be noisy. recommending run-on-merge + nightly-and-release pipelines. filed CRO-553 for the infra delta. added a unit test matrix case that mutates `user_context`.

maria-l: i'll draft a short customer-facing post for #support-updates once canary is live. closing loop once INC-2028 is resolved and the golden corpus is lint-clean. thanks all.

kenji-s: follow-up: after hotfix, we should schedule a short migration window where we log deprecations for clients still sending arrays, and then enforce the stricter schema in 30 days.

hana-cs: noted. i'll collect impacted customer list and prepare templated comms.

(End of thread)
